behavior.smooth_off: Successive saved frames; no sparse preview substitution during playback.
behavior.smooth_on: Interpolation between adjacent saved frames, respecting stage boundaries.
behavior.scrub: Immediate sparse preview while dragging, then exact settled frame.
behavior.buffer: Four saved frames prepared ahead, including loop wrap; cache misses hold the last exact frame.

validation.scope: Unit and integration tests for player, panel, display, MD adapter, and trajectory stream; no new full-application GPU timing benchmark.

physics_assessment.conclusion: Bussi is temperature control, not a calibrated local solvent-drag model. Underdamped mechanical modes are plausible but have not been diagnosed from exact frame data. Langevin/Brownian local drag and missing cooperative hydrodynamics must be distinguished.
